depmap.interpretation: More negative gene-effect values indicate stronger loss-of-fitness dependency; dependency is context- and cell-line-specific.

methodological_notes: No DepMap gene-effect values are hardcoded.
No drug connectivity scores are hardcoded.
LINCS directional queries require genuinely signed biomarker information.
Absence of an external dataset is reported as unavailable rather than imputed.
DepMap dependency is a functional cell-line vulnerability association, not clinical treatment evidence.
CMap/LINCS connectivity identifies transcriptomic signature relationships and does not establish therapeutic efficacy.
